QUERY.summary: Queries documents from a bucket using a filter expression.
QUERY.complexity: Depends on the query plan. O(N) where N is the number of documents the plan scans.

reply_schema.description: A cursor ID and the matching documents. The document encoding follows the session's reply_type attribute.

cursor_id.description: The cursor ID for BUCKET.ADVANCE. -1 means the LIMIT was reached and the cursor no longer exists.

entries.description: The matching documents. Each document includes its _id field.

items.description: A document encoded as BSON bytes or a JSON string.

arguments.name: bucket
arguments.summary: The name of the bucket to query.

arguments.name: query
arguments.summary: The filter expression that selects the documents to return.

arguments.name: sortby
arguments.summary: Return the results ordered by this field.

arguments.name: resultsort
arguments.summary: Sort each returned batch by this field.

arguments.name: json-spec
arguments.summary: A projection spec that selects the fields to return.

arguments.name: count
arguments.summary: The number of documents read per round trip. Defaults to the session batch size.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.summary: The highest number of documents to return. Zero means no limit.

arguments.name: json-spec
arguments.summary: A collation spec for locale aware string comparison in the filter.
